generations.prompt:
A light comic scene from a warm, old-fashioned television space adventure: adult actors on a practical starship lounge set, just after the Captain's formal speech to his crew.

The two adult women officers on either side of the Captain gush over him with exaggerated, starstruck enthusiasm, both talking at once and leaning in. The officer with the auburn bun presses her clasped hands to her chest and says: "That was beautiful, Captain!" The officer with the dark bob beams, steps closer and lays a hand warmly on his shoulder as she says: "So moving, sir. Truly!" The Captain, standing between them with his hands behind his back, tries to look modest and fails; he nods graciously to each, mouth closed, his smile growing. Behind them the last of the crew drift out. The camera holds steady.

The women's voices are bright, quick and effusive. The Captain does not speak.

Sound: the two spoken lines exactly as written, overlapping slightly, with a soft murmur of people leaving the room. No music, no narration, no other clear lines. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text.
